title: fix(service-datasource): a pool rebuild syncs the managed objects bound to the datasource (#27750)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D8TexLjwJ2KtVSbiAujiwfF)_

Fixes #27750

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：管理员修改一个 Setup 创建的托管数据源（换库、换凭据、改 schemaMode 或重新启用）导致连接池重建时，绑定到它的代码对象会在新库上建表。
- 为什么改：#27701 只修了"创建"和"重启"两条路；"修改后重建"仍不建表，换库后该对象每次读取都失败，只能手工建表。
- 风险与回滚：只对 `schemaMode: managed` 生效，`external` / `validate-only` 依旧零 DDL；重建失败保留旧池时不同步。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`datasource-admin-plugin.ts` 新的共用 helper `managedObjectsBoundTo`，以及 `reconnect` 新增的 `objects` 参数。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource exec vitest run src/__tests__/runtime-datasource-bound-object-storage.test.ts`（新增 3 例；回退连接服务的改动后换库那例变红）。
- 需要你做的：无（Tier S，按本期落地授权由席位落地）。

## What changes

- `DatasourceConnectionService.reconnect` takes an optional `objects` list and forwards it to both of its inner `connect` calls (the swap rebuild and the nothing-to-swap plain connect), so the connect's sync loop gives those objects their tables on the pool the new record opens. The kept-old-pool path syncs nothing.
- `DatasourceAdminServicePlugin`: the managed-only gate and bound-name list that `registerPool` computed inline (#27701) moved into one helper, `managedObjectsBoundTo`, which both `registerPool` and `reregisterPool` call. `reregisterPool` passes the objects bound to the NEW record.
- ⛔ `schemaMode: external` / `validate-only` still pass no objects, so they never get DDL.

## Why

#27701 synced bound managed objects when a runtime datasource's pool opens. An admin update that rebuilds the pool (`PATCH /api/v1/datasources/:name` → `updateDatasource` → `reregisterPool` → `reconnect`) still passed none, so moving `warehouse` to a new database left `wh_note` without a table there and every read of it failed.

## Verification

- Pinned red on `main` first: in `runtime-datasource-bound-object-storage.test.ts` (real plugin, real `ObjectQL`, SQLite), create `warehouse` on `a.db`, update `config` to `b.db` → `hasTable('wh_note')` was `false` on `b.db`. Green with the fix; ablating the connection-service change turns it red again, restoring turns it green.
- New ⛔ cases: `external` and `validate-only` datasources updated to a new database sync nothing and create no table.
- `@objectstack/service-datasource`: 63 files / 1031 tests pass; `tsc --noEmit` clean.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 60 derived families accounted for: 59 run green, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, needs a whole-tree build; CI runs it). `pnpm lint` exit 0. `check:commit-card-trailers` green.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.

Serial note: draft PR #27819 (#27746) edits both files; this PR keeps to `reconnect`, `registerPool` / `reregisterPool` and the shared helper. The later lander merges `main`.
